sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.body: Stajanka is an independent parking companion developed by Daniil Bortnik. Contact: sosambus@icloud.com. Stajanka does not operate parking areas, issue fines or act as a bank. It does not create a separate Stajanka account.

sections.title: Data on your device
sections.body: The app stores the plates, countries and optional nicknames you enter, your selected vehicle, language, and locally recorded parking attempts and paid periods. There is no developer-operated cloud database or automatic account sharing. iOS backups may contain local app data according to your device settings.

sections.title: Parking service requests
sections.body: To calculate a price, open checkout and verify parking, the app sends the selected plate, payment-zone identifier, duration, start time and vehicle tariff to Parkouka.by over HTTPS. Adding or selecting a vehicle can also check its current paid time across the supported zones. The country flag and nickname are local display data; they are not sent as parking-payment parameters. Parkouka and the parking operator retain their own transaction and account records under their policies.

sections.title: Optional account connection
sections.body: If you connect an existing Parkouka.by account, the email and password you enter are sent directly to that service for authentication. The password is not saved to persistent app storage. Session cookies are saved in the device-only iOS Keychain. Adding a vehicle to that account is optional and does not request registration documents or access to fines.

sections.title: Location and notifications
sections.body: With your permission, foreground location is used to show your position and nearby parking in Apple Maps. The app does not send your GPS location to Parkouka.by or to a developer server. You can use the map manually and revoke location access in iOS Settings. Local expiry reminders require notification permission; this app does not operate a remote push-notification service.

sections.title: Payments and provider pages
sections.body: ERIP opens a banking app or its payment website. Card checkout is provided by bePaid and may redirect to your bank for authentication. Card numbers, CVCs, cardholder details and bank credentials are entered in the provider or bank interface. Stajanka’s native code does not read or persist those fields. Provider pages may collect transaction, network and device-security data and use their own cookies and scripts. Network providers necessarily receive connection information such as your IP address. Their retention and processing are governed by their own notices.

sections.title: Analytics and support
sections.body: The native app contains no advertising SDK, advertising identifier access or developer analytics service. Embedded payment and merchant pages use web analytics, including cookie or browser identifiers and information about page interactions. These data support analytics, operation and security of the external services; they are not used for cross-service advertising tracking. The selected parking zone also conveys an approximate parking location, without transmitting GPS coordinates. The developer does not sell personal data or use it for advertising profiles. If you email support, the developer receives your email address and the information you choose to include, for handling that request and any applicable recordkeeping duties. Do not send card numbers, CVCs, banking passwords or one-time codes.

sections.title: Deletion and your choices
sections.body: Deleting a vehicle from the garage removes that garage entry; locally recorded parking sessions remain. Garage → About and data → Delete local data removes saved vehicles, local parking history, reminders and the saved login session from this device. It does not cancel a payment or delete records held by Parkouka, bePaid or a bank. Sign out or use this clear-data action before uninstalling if you want to remove the Keychain session. Manage an external Parkouka account directly with its operator. Contact support for questions about access, correction or deletion of information held by the developer.

sections.title: Scope and changes
sections.body: The app is intended for people arranging lawful parking, not specifically for children. Service providers may process data in other countries under their own policies. We will update this policy when the app’s processing changes and show the revision date. Mandatory privacy rights under applicable law remain unaffected.
